and his glory will be like the olive tree,

et germinabunt quasi vinea; memoriale ejus sicut vinum Libani.
and they will grow like a vine. His memorial will be like the wine of the cedars of Lebanon.
et dirigam eum ego ut abietem virentem;
and I will set him straight like a healthy spruce tree.
ex me fructus tuus inventus est.
Your fruit has been found by me.
Who is wise and will understand this?
Who has understanding and will know these things?
quia rectæ viæ Domini, et justi ambulabunt in eis;
For the ways of the Lord are straight, and the just will walk in them,
but truly, the traitors will fall in them.
